A dark scene is summoned and its essence corrupted.  
What emerges from the dark are known as Nightmare Vectors

title: An Oceanic Feeling
description:
There is nothing like spending time in a healthy flowing body of water. 

This is a composition of a 3d artwork modeled in Blender, and several reimagined videos based on it using Deforum Stable Diffusion and controlnets. The music was composed afterwards to match the vibe of the artwork.

title: Sigil of an Ancient Energy
description:
An ancient magical device, long lost to the sea, rediscovered and activated. What power could it hold? What was its purpose? Are we about to find out?

This artwork was made in Blender, Stable Diffusion and Affinity Photo.

title: Ritual Depths
description:
This piece, made in Blender and Stable Diffusion was inspired by my trip to the St Lawrence river, and my daily swims along the seaweed covered bottom.

The calligraphic shapes, central obsidian sphere, and blue haze was created in Blender, and rendered out in color and black and white. In SD those images were used as the content and depth references to accurately recreate the exact composition with enhanced scenery. The prompt: "aquatic ritual circle. A dark obsidian sphere at the center of runic magic stones. Deep underwater, softly illuminated."

title: Lightcycle
description: A timelapse photography session yielded some wonderful source material for this unique experiment.

title: Breathing Light
description: An rendering of an idea for a physical sculpture made of softly changing lights and powdercoated metals.

title: Forged Imbalance
description: Imperfections are what create character. Conformity is boring.

title: Obsidian Bloom
description:
This AI artwork was created from two important artworks in my history as an artist. 
The shape of the piece resembles LENS Vault, a 3d sculpture which was a DeFi-enabled NFT and my ATH sale of 2021. 
The core of this artwork resembles the Muse Token itself – an intricately carved obsidian artifact. 

The representation of my calligraphy as a blooming flower, glowing with energy represents my growth through various phases and into new realms. As I complete this artwork I also complete a move to a new home, and a transition to a new stage of my life – full time artist and builder in /cryptoart and /muse.

title: Chthonia
description: A calligraphic ritual synthesized into a subterranean system of stream fed hanging gardens.

title: Evolution I
description: In a time of transition, yearning for new explorations but stretched thin by responsibilities, I find myself letting go of previous compositional restraints and diving into a hyper maximalist style I previously avoided.

title: Basic Elements
description: Simple strokes form the basic elements of a calligraphic alphabet and my own asemic creations. As mesmerizing as they are arrayed symmetrically, they are beautiful in their own right.  Here we see two strokes repeated thrice, with simple gradients to accentuate their forms. Combined, they form something more powerful to behold.

title: Asemic Processing Unit
description: Dense asemic glyphs, pilot parallel pen and watercolor ink on bristol board, digitally manipulated

title: Unfolding Hexagonal Blossom
description: A complex asemic calligraphy glyph with blended watercolor inks on paper was photographed, reflected and recolored to reveal a remarkably intricate artwork.

title: We Create The Future
description:
We are energetic beings with the capacity to change the world around us. When we combine our energies, we become more than the sum of our parts. As a community we can change the world.

Created with Glitchlab Pro, Stable Diffusion and Affinity Photo

title: Morphic Modules
description:
A structure of interlinked light modules pulsating with energy.

This artwork began as a hexagonal abstract glitchart composition. It was reinterpreted several times over in Stable Diffusion. The final version consists of four frames stitched together.

title: Reinterpretation I
description:
Practice is the purpose. With repetition, the meaning reveals itself.

Made with Pilot Parallel pen and water color inks on heavyweight paper, with digitally manipulated colors and reflections

title: Focus III
description: Asemic glyphs reframed from paper to an N-dimensional perspective. These watercolor broadpen strokes were digitally altered with several tools before landing on this other-worldly sphere - a focal point for your psychedelic meditations -  A yantra that beckons for your full attention.

title: Artifact I

A seamless loop of a starship made of 8 calligraphic shapes in a wireframe tunnel flythrough.

title: Twisted Glyph

title: Focus II
description: A simple practice can be reframed to reveal infinite unknown possibilities. This simple glyphic abstract, photographed and modified digitally brings the pen and paper to a completely different dimension.

title: Place in Time
description:
Simultaneous scenes intersecting.

Created with ai and digital image manipulation.

title: Focus I
description:
Amid the chaotic dance of daily life, find your focal point.

Abstract calligraphy with pilot parallel pen on paper, digital tools.

title: Data Rot
description:
One day your old Opensea links will decay into oblivion. Those centralized servers will go belly up as they slack on maintenance to chase the next opportunity. Here I imagine the data on a server, slowly rusting until its irretrievable. 

Midjourney, twisted and glitched with Glitchlab Pro.

title: Infernal Conjuring
description: Calligraphic abstract, drawn in Procreate, Affinity Photo & Affinity Designer, subtly reinterpreted with Stable Diffusion as 4 frames, stitched together as a GIF.

title: Dimensional LENS 1
description:
This 3D meditative abstract is my very first minted 3D file. It uses standard gltf shaders and can be loaded into any 3D world such as OnCyber or Decentraland.  
It is named as a tribute to my very first onchain artworks which all 3D and I coined LENS artworks. The LENS Collection, deployed in late 2020, were 3D editions, some animated, all made in Blender.

title: Unraveled Crystalline Mechanism
description: A new exploration of form. This work began as a meditative calligraphic ring much like my other works. It was heavily reworked digitally and then reinterpreted with AI as a deep space entity of unknown origin. The image was further reworked with procreate and expanded with Stable Diffusion inpainting and outpainting.

title: Verdant Runes of Eternal Growth
description:
These abstract glyphs have been meticulously crafted into concentric meditative circles, symbolically reintegrated with the natural world to restore their essence to the life force they originated from.

Materials:  
Pilot parallel pens  
Glitchlab Pro  
Stable Diffusion

title: Lustruous Glyphs
description:
"In the labyrinthine sprawl of the city after dusk, where the neon glow seeps into every crevice, a serendipitous convergence occurs. It is an event unseen, as algorithms, like clandestine architects, orchestrate an interplay of light and geometry, distilling the ephemeral human experience into layered echoes. Here, amidst the pulsing arteries of the urban expanse, a fleeting narrative takes shape, its contours defined by a silent dialogue between the binary and the organic—a singular instance where time-honored patterns are woven into the fabric of an ever-evolving now."

An experiment combining AI generated double-exposure lomography with calligraphic circular abstracts. This piece combines three AI models, generated based on a series of ai portraits and calligraphy images. The above prose was collaboratively written with ChatGPT.

title: Sunken Sanctuary
description:
In the depths of an ancient world, where the boundaries between organic life and crafted existence blur, lies the relic known as the "Submerged Sanctuary." It is a fragment of a once-great civilization that found harmony in the embrace of the ocean's depths. The metropolis, now a canvas for coral and a cradle for the creatures of the deep, echoes with the silent songs of a time when humanity wove their structures into the very fabric of the sea. A time when the architects of old, in their pinnacle of triumph, bent not just steel and glass to their will, but the very currents and lifeblood of the ocean itself. This submerged realm, with its luminescent heart, is not merely a place but a living chronicle of an epoch when the sea itself was home.

This artwork is a collaboration between myself and my AI tools. What began as a pure procedural artwork made in Glitchlab in my signature circular format was reinterpreted as an aquatic lost habitat teeming with life. Its a tribute to the worlds created in Synthetic Habitats. Where those were pure AI works, this is a collaboration with AI. The backstory above is a collaboration with ChatGPT.

title: Frosty Solstice
description: A chilly AI interpretation of a calligraphic meditation as a snow-covered living wreath of holly. Minted on the 2023 winter solstice.

title: Jagged Harmony
description:
This piece began as a calligraphy meditation, with pen on paper with watercolor inks. It was photographed and digitally manipulated to change the color palette. Finally it was subtly reinterpreted with AI into several frames which were stitched together into this animated GIF.

This artwork is the first piece airdropped to Muse Token Subscribers on the Muse Editions contract on Base.

title: SOURCE
description: A Generative Adversarial Network was trained on a large set of my calligraphic and glitch artworks. This image was curated from 100s of iterations as an especially unique bridging of the two styles. The GAN imagery also feeds the other pieces in the collection. This is the only pure GAN image in the Reaching The Source collection.

Day 24 of my self-imposed Render till December challenge.

This one's straight out of a Ducky3d tutorial again. Trying to strengthen my weaknesses in shaders and geonodes. Learned a compositor node I hadn't touched too, which gives it that nice grainy effect. 

You can make the same thing from one of his recent tutorials.

title: Day 26

I'm stoked to be getting more and more familiar with geometry nodes and how they can work hand in hand with shaders. Made some creative choices and added in some extra compositor nodes (lens distortion & chromatic aberration)

title: Day 30
description:
Today is my last day in this beautiful riverside cottage. Mostly spending the day cleaning and packing. Today's render (day 30!) is a lesson in using cloth-sim for soft-body physics. The sphere is "rubber" fabric with outward pressure to simulate a ball.

title: Day 44
description:
Day 44 was productive but not in terms of great 3d compositions. more so blender tools. 
I made a music sequencer app that spits out messages when anything happens (note plays, filter changes frequency etc) and a blender plugin that reads those messages as signals that can be mapped to any parameter.

Pictured below is evidence that I still have work to do autosyncing recorded sound to video

and below that is the blender plugin. You can use Supercollider to write music with code that can talk to it.
https://github.com/mxjxn/osc-score-bridge
https://supercollider.github.io/
